quibble.zh: 小爭議；吹毛求疵的異議
ai: I have just one small quibble with your plan.
我對你的計畫只有一個小小的異議。
Her only quibble about the hotel was the noisy elevator.
她對這家旅館唯一的挑剔是電梯很吵。
Let's not quibble over a few dollars.
我們別為了幾塊錢斤斤計較。
They quibbled about the wording for an hour.
他們為了措辭爭論了一個小時。
The room was small and unadorned, with white walls and a single bed.
房間又小又簡樸，只有白牆和一張單人床。
She preferred an unadorned dress to a fancy one.
她喜歡素雅的洋裝勝過華麗的。
He gave the unadorned truth, without any exaggeration.
他說出不加修飾的實話，毫不誇大。
Many birds fly to a warmer clime for the winter.
許多鳥會飛到較溫暖的地方過冬。
He moved to a sunnier clime after he retired.
他退休後搬到陽光更充足的地方。
The old tradition had a malign influence on young people.
這個舊傳統對年輕人有不良影響。
She felt a malign look from across the room.
她感覺到房間另一頭投來的惡意目光。
He felt unfairly maligned by the newspaper.
他覺得報紙對他不公平地中傷。
Don't malign your coworkers behind their backs.
不要在背後說同事的壞話。
The baby slept, untroubled by the noise outside.
寶寶睡得很安穩，絲毫不受外面的噪音影響。
She walked home with an untroubled mind.
她心情平靜地走路回家。
He seemed untroubled by the bad news.
他似乎沒有被壞消息困擾。
A possum was digging through the trash can last night.
昨晚有隻負鼠在翻垃圾桶。
When scared, a possum may pretend to be dead.
負鼠受到驚嚇時可能會裝死。
Lying to your friend like that was unforgivable.
那樣對朋友說謊是不可原諒的。
She said his rude behavior was simply unforgivable.
她說他的無禮行為根本不可原諒。
Forgetting her birthday felt like an unforgivable mistake.
忘了她的生日讓我覺得是個不可原諒的錯誤。
The two boys got into a tussle over the ball.
兩個男孩為了球扭打起來。
There was a long tussle between the two parties over the budget.
兩黨為了預算爭執了很久。
The puppies tussled on the grass all afternoon.
小狗整個下午都在草地上互相打鬧。
The kids tussled over the last slice of pizza.
孩子們為了最後一片披薩吵成一團。
The poet wrote an elegy for his late friend.
詩人為已故的朋友寫了一首哀歌。
The orchestra played a quiet elegy at the memorial.
樂團在追思會上演奏了一首安靜的輓歌。
Don't give me that baloney; I know the truth.
別拿那些鬼話唬我，我知道真相。
He said he was too busy, but that was just baloney.
他說他太忙，但那只是藉口胡扯。
I made a baloney sandwich for lunch.
我午餐做了一個大紅腸三明治。
He sliced some baloney and put it in a roll.
他切了幾片大紅腸夾進麵包裡。
They argued over a trifling amount of money.
他們為了一筆微不足道的錢爭吵。
It's a trifling matter, so don't worry about it.
這只是件小事，不用擔心。
She was upset by such a trifling mistake.
她為這麼一個小錯誤而心煩。
The two lived a chaste life in the quiet village.
兩人在寧靜的村子裡過著清白的生活。
It was a chaste kiss on the cheek.
那只是臉頰上一個純真的吻。
We usually have biscuits at teatime.
我們通常在下午茶時間吃餅乾。
Come over around teatime and we'll chat.
下午茶時間過來吧，我們聊聊天。
Bears go into hibernation when winter comes.
冬天來臨時，熊會進入冬眠。
The frog came out of hibernation in early spring.
青蛙在初春從冬眠中醒來。
During hibernation, an animal's heartbeat slows down a lot.
冬眠期間，動物的心跳會變得很慢。
Many people in the village were afflicted with a strange illness.
村裡許多人罹患了一種怪病。
She was afflicted by constant headaches for years.
她多年來一直受頭痛所苦。
Her naivety made her easy to fool.
她的天真讓她很容易被騙。
I was surprised by his naivety about money.
他對金錢的天真讓我很驚訝。
The singer soon had many imitators.
那位歌手很快就有了許多模仿者。
A good imitator can copy a voice almost perfectly.
厲害的模仿者幾乎能完美複製一個人的聲音。
He wore a ratty old sweater to the party.
他穿著一件破舊的毛衣去參加派對。
The sofa looked ratty after years of use.
沙發用了多年後看起來破破爛爛的。
Don't be so ratty with me; I'm only trying to help.
別對我這麼沒好氣，我只是想幫忙。
He gets ratty when he's tired.
他累的時候就容易發脾氣。
She wore a shapeless gray coat.
她穿著一件不成形的灰色外套。
The clay was still a shapeless lump on the table.
黏土在桌上還只是一團沒有形狀的東西。
His essay felt shapeless, with no clear structure.
他的文章鬆散不成形，沒有清楚的架構。
Hoarding food during a storm only makes shortages worse.
暴風雨期間囤積食物只會讓缺貨更嚴重。
His hoarding of old newspapers filled the whole garage.
他囤積舊報紙，把整個車庫都塞滿了。
A tall hoarding surrounded the building site.
一道高高的圍籬圍著建築工地。
A huge advertising hoarding stood beside the road.
路邊立著一個巨大的廣告看板。
She is a regular exerciser who runs every morning.
她是個固定運動的人，每天早上都跑步。
The small exerciser under his desk helps him stay active.
他桌下的小型健身器材讓他保持活動。
Finding the cause was mostly guesswork at first.
一開始找出原因大多只能靠猜。
Use a scale and take the guesswork out of baking.
用秤來量，烘焙就不用再靠猜了。
Cattle graze on the open rangeland all summer.
牛群整個夏天都在開闊的牧場上吃草。
Much of the western rangeland is dry and dusty.
西部大部分的牧場乾燥又多塵土。

lifter.zh: 舉重者；舉起東西的人或裝置
ai: The weight lifter trained at the gym every day.
那位舉重選手每天都在健身房訓練。
A strong lifter can raise twice his own weight.
強壯的舉重者能舉起自己體重兩倍的重量。

fiddly.zh: 瑣碎費手的；需要細心操作的
ai: Putting in the tiny screws was a fiddly job.
裝那些小螺絲是件很費手的工作。
The buttons on this jacket are small and fiddly.
這件外套的釦子又小又難扣。
He was disinclined to go out in the rain.
他不想在下雨天出門。
I'm disinclined to believe a story like that.
我不太願意相信那樣的說法。
The statue's head was decapitated by a falling branch.
雕像的頭被掉落的樹枝砸斷了。
In the old story, the king threatened to decapitate the thief.
在古老的故事裡，國王威脅要將小偷斬首。

deservedly.zh: 理所當然地；當之無愧地
ai: She was deservedly praised for her hard work.
她的努力受到稱讚，實至名歸。
The team deservedly won the championship.
那支隊伍當之無愧地贏得了冠軍。
The cat purred contentedly on her lap.
貓咪在她腿上滿足地呼嚕著。
He sat back and sipped his tea contentedly.
他往後靠著，心滿意足地啜著茶。
Tokyo is one of the most densely populated cities in the world.
東京是世界上人口最稠密的城市之一。
The island is sparsely populated, with only a few farms.
這座島人口稀少，只有幾座農場。
The long climb did not daunt the young hikers.
漫長的攀登沒有嚇倒年輕的登山客。
Don't let one failure daunt you.
別讓一次失敗打倒你。
The trumpeter played a lively tune at the festival.
小號手在慶典上吹奏了一首輕快的曲子。
He wants to become a jazz trumpeter someday.
他希望有一天成為爵士小號手。

hereinafter.zh: 以下；在下文中（法律用語）
ai: The company, hereinafter called the Seller, agrees to the terms.
本公司（以下簡稱賣方）同意這些條款。
The two parties are hereinafter referred to as the Partners.
雙方以下合稱為合夥人。

debrief.zh: 聽取任務報告；事後詢問
ai: The manager will debrief the team after the project ends.
專案結束後，經理會聽取團隊的報告。
Police debriefed the witness for two hours.
警方詢問了目擊者兩個小時。
The writer used an alias to protect her privacy.
作家用化名來保護自己的隱私。
The suspect was known by several aliases.
這名嫌犯有好幾個別名。
The ejection of the noisy fans surprised no one.
吵鬧的球迷被趕出場，沒有人感到意外。
The pilot's ejection from the plane saved his life.
飛行員彈射離機救了他一命。
The world's economies are deeply interconnected.
世界各國的經濟緊密相連。
These interconnected rooms make the house feel open.
這些相通的房間讓整間屋子感覺很開闊。
We took the expressway to avoid the city traffic.
我們走高速公路以避開市區的車潮。
The new expressway cuts the trip down to one hour.
新的高速公路把車程縮短到一個小時。
The children enjoyed tracing the shapes onto thin paper.
孩子們喜歡把圖形描在薄紙上。
Tracing the source of the leak took all morning.
追查漏水的源頭花了一整個早上。
The customer left unsatisfied with the service.
那位顧客對服務不滿意地離開了。
She felt unsatisfied after such a small meal.
吃了這麼少的一餐，她覺得還沒吃飽。
A sample of ten people is unrepresentative of the whole country.
十個人的樣本不能代表整個國家。
That one bad review is unrepresentative of what most customers think.
那則負評不能代表大多數顧客的想法。
The drummer dropped a drumstick in the middle of the song.
鼓手在歌曲中途掉了一根鼓棒。
He tapped the table with a drumstick to keep the beat.
他用鼓棒敲著桌子打拍子。
He ate a chicken drumstick with his fingers.
他用手拿著雞棒腿吃。
The kids all wanted a drumstick for dinner.
孩子們晚餐都想吃棒棒腿。
The baby is cranky because of teething.
寶寶因為長牙而鬧脾氣。
Teething can make babies drool a lot.
長牙會讓嬰兒流很多口水。
Do you want to swop seats with me?
你要不要跟我換座位？
The boys swop trading cards at school.
男孩們在學校交換卡片。
It was a fair swop: my book for your magazine.
這是公平的交換：我的書換你的雜誌。
They did a swop of houses for the summer holiday.
他們暑假時互換了房子住。
This programmable thermostat saves energy.
這個可程式化的恆溫器能節省能源。
She bought a programmable coffee maker that starts before she wakes up.
她買了一台可預先設定的咖啡機，在她起床前就會開始煮。
A sudden squall tipped over the small boat.
一陣突來的強風把小船打翻了。
We waited under a tree until the squall passed.
我們在樹下等到那陣狂風驟雨過去。
The baby squalled all night.
寶寶整晚尖聲大哭。
The toddler squalled when his toy was taken away.
玩具被拿走時，小男孩哇哇大哭。
The doctor treated him for congestive heart failure.
醫生為他治療充血性心臟衰竭。
Congestive symptoms include a blocked nose and a heavy chest.
充血症狀包括鼻塞和胸悶。
The curtain was tied back with a gold tassel.
窗簾用一條金色流蘇綁起來。
Graduates move the tassel on their caps to the other side.
畢業生把帽子上的流蘇撥到另一邊。
Engineers checked the soundness of the bridge.
工程師檢查了橋的穩固程度。
The soundness of her argument impressed everyone.
她論點的完備讓每個人印象深刻。
He gave a sheepish smile when he was caught.
被抓到時，他露出不好意思的笑容。
She felt sheepish about forgetting his name.
她因為忘了他的名字而覺得很尷尬。
The garden is the showpiece of the whole estate.
這座花園是整個莊園最引以為傲的部分。
The new stadium is a showpiece for the city.
新體育場是這座城市的門面之作。
The young starlet attended her first film festival.
年輕的新星參加了她的第一個影展。
Magazines called her the brightest starlet of the year.
雜誌稱她為年度最耀眼的新星。
The prices are ranging from five to fifty dollars.
價格從五元到五十元不等。
We had a long talk, ranging over many topics.
我們聊了很久，話題包羅萬象。
A sinuous river wound through the valley.
一條蜿蜒的河流穿過山谷。
The dancer moved with sinuous grace.
舞者以柔軟流暢的姿態舞動。
The harried waiter ran between the crowded tables.
焦頭爛額的服務生在擁擠的桌子間奔跑。
She looked harried after a long day with the kids.
和孩子們忙了一整天後，她看起來疲憊不堪。
He caught a huge tarpon off the coast of Florida.
他在佛羅里達外海釣到一條巨大的海鰱。
A tarpon can leap high out of the water when hooked.
海鰱上鉤時能跳出水面很高。
He plausibly explained why he was late.
他很合情合理地解釋了自己為什麼遲到。
The story could plausibly be true.
這個故事有可能是真的。
Shoals of small fish swam past the divers.
一群群小魚從潛水員身旁游過。
Fishing boats followed the shoals of herring along the coast.
漁船沿著海岸追隨著鯡魚群。
The ship ran aground on the shoals.
船在淺灘上擱淺了。
Sailors avoid these shoals during low tide.
水手在退潮時會避開這些淺灘。
The accident left him paralysed from the waist down.
那場意外讓他腰部以下癱瘓。
She stood paralysed with fear as the dog ran toward her.
狗朝她跑來時，她嚇得動彈不得。
She performed outstandingly in the final exam.
她在期末考中表現得非常出色。
The food was outstandingly good.
這些食物好吃得出類拔萃。
I preheated the oven to 180 degrees.
我把烤箱預熱到 180 度。
Once the pan is preheated, add the oil.
平底鍋預熱好之後，再加油。
The pianist gave a masterly performance.
鋼琴家演出得非常精湛。
He handled the difficult negotiation in a masterly way.
他以高明的手法處理了這場困難的談判。
The project has manifold benefits for the community.
這個計畫對社區有多方面的好處。
Her reasons for leaving were manifold.
她離開的原因有很多種。
The mechanic replaced a cracked exhaust manifold.
技師換掉了裂開的排氣歧管。
The engine's intake manifold carries air to each cylinder.
引擎的進氣歧管把空氣送到每個汽缸。
Thick walls attenuate the sound from the street.
厚牆能削弱街上傳來的噪音。
Signals attenuate as they travel through long cables.
訊號在長電纜中傳輸時會衰減。
The actor's clear diction made every word easy to hear.
演員清晰的咬字讓每個字都聽得很清楚。
The poet's diction is simple but powerful.
這位詩人的用字簡單卻有力。
No one could foretell what would happen next.
沒有人能預知接下來會發生什麼事。
The old woman claimed she could foretell the weather.
老婦人聲稱她能預測天氣。
He peeked through the keyhole to see who was inside.
他從鑰匙孔偷看裡面是誰。
I couldn't fit the key into the keyhole in the dark.
黑暗中我沒辦法把鑰匙插進鑰匙孔。
Loud noise is inimical to good sleep.
大噪音對好眠是有害的。
The new rules are inimical to small businesses.
新規定對小型企業不利。
He is so gullible that he believes every advertisement.
他太容易受騙，每個廣告都信。
Scammers often target gullible people.
詐騙集團常以輕信的人為目標。
A frisson of excitement ran through the crowd.
一陣興奮的顫慄竄過人群。
She felt a frisson of fear as the door creaked open.
門嘎吱打開時，她感到一陣恐懼的戰慄。
Please familiarise yourself with the safety rules.
請先熟悉安全規則。
The guide familiarised us with the city map.
導遊讓我們熟悉了市區地圖。
Dog excrement on the sidewalk is unpleasant.
人行道上的狗糞很討人厭。
Farmers use animal excrement as fertilizer.
農民把動物糞便當肥料。
The children visited the firehouse on a school trip.
孩子們校外教學時參觀了消防站。
A siren sounded from the firehouse down the street.
街尾的消防站傳來警報聲。

damning.zh: 極為不利的；足以定罪的
ai: The report contained damning evidence against the company.
這份報告包含了對該公司極為不利的證據。
His damning remarks ended the discussion.
他的嚴厲指責讓討論就此結束。
She bought the hat on a whim and with a touch of whimsy.
她一時興起買了那頂帽子，帶點異想天開的趣味。
The cafe is decorated with charm and whimsy.
這間咖啡廳的裝潢充滿魅力和奇趣。
The rich man's largesse helped build the new library.
那位富人的慷慨捐助促成了新圖書館的興建。
She was known for her largesse toward her friends.
她對朋友的慷慨出了名。
The room was hot and suffocating.
房間又熱又悶得讓人喘不過氣。
He felt the suffocating pressure of so many deadlines.
他感到被這麼多截止日期壓得喘不過氣。
The smoke was suffocating the people trapped inside.
濃煙讓被困在裡面的人們窒息。
Too many weeds are suffocating the young plants.
太多雜草讓幼苗透不過氣。
He is a real charmer and everyone likes him.
他是個很有魅力的人，大家都喜歡他。
The little girl was a charmer who won over the whole class.
小女孩很討喜，讓全班都喜歡她。
We rented a small Tuscan farmhouse for the summer.
我們租了一棟托斯卡納的小農舍過夏天。
The Tuscan hills are famous for their vineyards.
托斯卡納的丘陵以葡萄園聞名。
She tried to remonstrate with the driver about his speed.
她試著勸那位駕駛不要開那麼快。
Residents remonstrated against the plan to close the park.
居民抗議關閉公園的計畫。
He read the report in a flat monotone.
他用平板單調的語調念報告。
The teacher's monotone put half the class to sleep.
老師單調的聲音讓半個班級都睡著了。
She chose a monotone painting for the office wall.
她為辦公室牆面選了一幅單色調的畫。
The singer's monotone voice bored the audience.
歌手單調的嗓音讓聽眾覺得無聊。
She had a saintly patience with her students.
她對學生有著聖人般的耐心。
He led a saintly life, helping the poor.
他過著聖潔的生活，幫助窮人。
He sat in a corner, morose and silent.
他坐在角落，悶悶不樂又沉默。
She grew morose after losing her job.
丟了工作後，她變得鬱鬱寡歡。

suave.zh: 圓滑而有禮的；風度翩翩的
ai: The suave host greeted every guest by name.
那位風度翩翩的主人一一叫出每位賓客的名字。
He gave a suave reply and avoided the question.
他很圓滑地回答，避開了那個問題。
I do my washing at the launderette on the corner.
我在轉角的自助洗衣店洗衣服。
The launderette stays open until ten at night.
這間自助洗衣店營業到晚上十點。
The boat got stuck on a sandbar near the river mouth.
船在河口附近的沙洲上擱淺了。
At low tide, a long sandbar appeared in the bay.
退潮時，海灣裡露出一道長長的沙洲。
The politico spent years in city hall.
那位政客在市政廳待了好幾年。
Seasoned politicos know how to work a room.
經驗老到的政客知道怎麼周旋於人群之間。
The pilot aborted the landing and flew around again.
機師中止降落，再度繞圈。
They aborted the experiment after the machine failed.
機器故障後，他們中止了實驗。
The aborted launch was rescheduled for next week.
被取消的發射改到下週。
After the aborted attempt, the team tried again.
